description: This file defines the EscaperNodeVisitor class, which implements a node visitor for Twig templates to handle automatic escaping of output for security purposes.

classes.name: Twig\NodeVisitor\EscaperNodeVisitor
classes.description: A final class implementing NodeVisitorInterface to handle auto-escaping logic in Twig templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EscaperNodeVisitor with a SafeAnalysisNodeVisitor instance.

methods.name: enterNode
methods.description: Handles logic when entering a node, setting up escaping context based on node type.

methods.name: leaveNode
methods.description: Handles logic when leaving a node, applying escaping filters and managing context stacks.

methods.name: escapeConditional
methods.description: Recursively escapes operands within an OperatorEscapeInterface expression.

methods.name: escapeExpression
methods.description: Returns a safe expression or wraps it with an escape filter based on safety analysis.

methods.name: preEscapeFilterNode
methods.description: Prepares a FilterExpression node for escaping based on its pre-escape type.

methods.name: isSafeFor
methods.description: Determines if an expression is safe for a given escape type using SafeAnalysis.

methods.name: needEscaping
methods.description: Returns the current escaping status from the stack or default strategy.

methods.name: getEscaperFilter
methods.description: Creates a FilterExpression node for escaping a given expression with a specified type.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of this node visitor, defaulting to 0.
